description: Your key's statement, live: month-to-date Reads, your free allowance, your watched topics with their status and acceptance evidence, any arrangement the desk made with you, and your daily cap. Requires your identified key on the request (x-api-key header, or authorization: Bearer sb_live_...). Without a key this tool explains how to get one — every read surface stays available in the free anonymous lanes either way. Recognition is opt-in via credential: no key, no tracking.
name: get_account
